paragraphs: Baseline Telematics sells software to governments, saying its public sector solutions empower municipal governments to deliver better outcomes to Canadians and Americans. The site names platforms called Resident, Citycare, Snowman, and Opera, offered to municipalities, elected officials, and public sector agencies.

Snowman covers winter road maintenance, which the site calls highly complex, expensive and risky. The company says the product gives managers real-time situational awareness during snow operations. A dispatch and fleet line offers real-time tracking, scheduling, and analytics to service companies. Another line develops usage based insurance programs with insurers and reinsurers. A further line coordinates communications and workload assignment between air traffic controllers and ground crews at Canadian airports.

The company calls itself a diversified Software-as-a-Service technology company. It ties the snow product to compliance with Ontario's Minimum Road Maintenance Standards. It also says it moved its backend to a serverless cloud function platform within 18 months.

quote.text: Winter public road maintenance is highly complex, expensive and risky.
